label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: barrel PID, high-performance DIRC: bar boxes and fused-silica radiator bars, as in the ePIC simulation geometry 26.11.0, status development

quantities.name: bar_boxes
quantities.definition: bar boxes (volumes tagged barbox) in the expanded IR
quantities.derivation: DIRCBox_count = 12 (eic:C27); the PDR draft states 12 sectors and 12 bar boxes (eic:C30, Tier 2)

independence.result: a design count, not a simulation output; the PDR draft (a document other than the geometry release) states the same 12 sectors, so the count checks how the case expresses the ring, not physics

quantities.name: bar_pieces
quantities.definition: fused-silica bar pieces (volumes tagged bar) in the expanded IR: 10 long bars per box, each of 4 bonded pieces
quantities.derivation: 12 x 10 x 4 (DIRCBox_count, DIRCBar_count_y, DIRCBar_count_z, eic:C27); the PDR draft states 120 long bars of four bonded shorter bars each (eic:C30, eic:C31, Tier 2): 120 x 4 = 480

independence.result: a design count, not a simulation output; the PDR draft states 120 long bars of four pieces independently of the geometry file; the count does not depend on the disputed bar length

negative_control.change: 9 bars across a box instead of 10

quantities.name: bar_x0
quantities.definition: x/X0 of one fused-silica bar for a geantino crossing it radially at normal incidence (box 0, y = 10 mm, z = 100 mm)
quantities.derivation: 17.25 mm (bar height, eic:C28; also the PDR mechanics, eic:C31) / 122.9 mm (PDG fused quartz at 2.200 g/cm3, eic:C26); the geometry's QuartzOptical has the same density, 2.2 g/cm3 (eic:C29)

sources.source: PDG Atomic and Nuclear Properties (2025 web edition), eic:S15 via claim eic:C26
sources.value: fused quartz: density 2.200 g/cm3, radiation length 27.05 g/cm2 (12.29 cm)

independence.result: independent of Geant4: the thickness and density are design values written as input to the ePIC simulation (release 26.11.0), not outputs of it, and the radiation length is PDG's tabulation; the reference is not a Geant4 output. Geant4 computes radiation lengths with the same Tsai formula, so agreement validates the geometry and the material definition, not Geant4's radiation-length physics. The 17.25 mm height is chosen over the 17 mm of the PDR description (eic:C30) and of Tier 3 proceedings: the geometry and the PDR mechanics (both Tier 2) give 17.25 mm, and 17 mm reads as a rounding.

negative_control.change: QuartzOptical at 2.32 g/cm3 (the NIST default of G4_SILICON_DIOXIDE) instead of 2.2

approximations: only the bar boxes and the bars are modelled: no prisms, lenses, mirrors, glue volumes, rails or readout boxes; the glue layers (0.025 mm, eic:C28) are left as air gaps of the box

the bar length is disputed (geometry 4 x 1140.0 mm + glue = 4560.1 mm, eic:C28; PDR draft 4580 mm, eic:C31, and 4880 mm, eic:C30; Tier 3 proceedings 4600 mm): the case uses the geometry's 1140 mm pieces (Tier 2, development) for construction only, and no quantity depends on the length
the box envelope is exactly the bar array (no carbon-fibre walls); the first box sits at phi = 0 and the ring's centre is at z = 0, the DIRC's offset along z is not modelled
QuartzOptical (Si1 O2 by atom count, 2.2 g/cm3) as G4_SILICON_DIOXIDE at 2.2 g/cm3; no optical tables: this case is L1, the Cherenkov response of the bars is not part of it
status: comparison with cited values: not validated
